programme: ShotSight Virtual Shooter — Learn to Shoot

l2_planning_heldout.interpretation: Representation is perception-sensitive and method-distinct, but this is not a target-break success metric.

governing_rule: ORACLE KNOWS. SHOOTER PERCEIVES, BELIEVES, ACTS, REMEMBERS AND LEARNS.
negative_findings: Inherited canonical flat-crosser exposes exact intercept/physical lead and must remain hidden oracle/reference truth only.
Current target engine does not certify realistic clay aerodynamics; virtual-shooter results must retain provisional world-model status.
Current centreline evaluator is a 110 mm disc sensitivity proxy only; it does not model target orientation, shot cloud or breakability.
Naive point-at-extrapolated-target baseline is intentionally weak and achieved 0/12 proxy hits; it is a lower baseline, not a human-performance claim.
Base L1 stable-crosser uncertainty was materially under-dispersed; held-out calibration requires large azimuth sigma scale factors of roughly 2.0–3.5 depending on observation condition.
Condition-specific global uncertainty scaling is an acceptable calibration gate but not the desired final belief architecture; a more principled heteroscedastic model should be tested later.
Perfect left/right direction accuracy on simple stable crossers is an easy-task result, not general target-reading proof.
Multi-family 300 ms reading is useful but crosser-v-quarterer remains materially harder than looper recognition.

Poor 220 ms acquisition collapses crosser-v-quarterer discrimination to 0.1833 accuracy; the model correctly lowers confidence but is not decision-ready in that condition without additional information.
Current looper family is a gravity-only engineering toy with an unusually strong vertical-curvature signature; 1.0 looper recall is not real-clay looper validation.
A first unconstrained WAIT_FOR_MORE_INFORMATION policy degenerated into waiting on every held-out target and correctly failed CI; selectivity is now an explicit behavioural gate.

Always waiting 100 ms materially outperforms the current selective policy on pure poor-view classification accuracy; later stages must price the lost shooting opportunity before claiming an optimal wait policy.
The fitted 50/100/150 ms observation waits, noise conditions and thresholds are SHOTSIGHT_HYPOTHESIS experimental parameters, not universal human timing prescriptions.
Global temperature scaling calibrates confidence but does not make the prototype family model a rich heteroscedastic representation.
No Brett Winstanley hold/pickup/break-point claim promoted without a recovered primary source.
L2 source-informed plans score lower than the blank-slate control on the current internal structure proxy; therefore that proxy is bookkeeping only and must not become a surrogate success objective.

Under poor perception the current L2 rule delays break planning to roughly 0.9635-0.9686, exposing the need to trade information gain against remaining shooting opportunity rather than simply delaying commitment.

The first L2 plan maps presentation variables onto only the 0.12 s local belief horizon; this is insufficient as a model of a human pre-call hold/pickup/break plan and must be replaced by a shooter-visible presentation-level coordinate before motor/trigger learning.
next_action: Implement SHOOTER_VISIBLE_PRESENTATION_CONTEXT_V1 and move hold/pickup/connection/break planning from the local 0.12 s belief horizon to a presentation-level shooter-visible coordinate. Then test source priors versus blank-slate controls on held-out crossers while explicitly pricing value of additional visual information against remaining runway/opportunity. Do not advance to motor/trigger learning until this repair is green and do not expose oracle intercept, exact lead, range or hidden future trajectory.
